======================================================
 Madhurendra Kumar Singh S/O Nand Kishore Singh @ Chandra Kishore  Singh Resident of Ibrahim Parsauni, P.S.- Phenhara, Dist.- East Champar

Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Ritu Devi D/O Late Ramjanam Singh R/O Ashopur, P.O.- Bairia, P.S.-
 Piprahi, Dist.- Sheohar.
 ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Kundan Rathore, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Parmanand Kumar, A.P.P  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DR. ANSHUMAN  ORAL ORDER 3 09-05-2025 Heard Learned counsel for the petitioner and Learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. C1-151/2021 dated 02.06.2021, for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 420, 452, 498(A), 406, 506, 504 &
34 of the IPC and D.P Act.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that notice has been issued upon the complainant/O.P. No.2 under speed post with A/D as well as through ordinary process which has been served, but even then, O.P. No.2 has not appeared.
Counsel submits that marriage was solemnized and thereafter, O.P. no.2 has filed one case under section 498(A) of the IPC Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.6390 of 2025(3) dt.09-05-2025 against the petitioner which is still pending and compromise was filed but subsequently, the present case has been filed in which cognizance has been taken under Sections 323, 498(A) & 34 of the IPC.
Counsel submits that the petitioner is doing private job outside the state i.e. in Andhra Pradesh.

Counsel further submits that petitioner has lodged a Matrimonial Case No.117/2020 against the complainant and later on, when she got information about this, then in retaliation, she has filed the present case as false and fabricated against the petitioner.

Counsel submits that the petitioner is a law abiding citizen and ready to fulfill Madhurendra Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124444170/
1 all the conditions whatsoever shall be imposed upon him.

entities.text: Madhurendra Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioner himself offered payment of Rs.3,000/- (Rupees Three Thousand) per month to the complainant.

4. Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail of the petitioner but submits that petitioner is ready to pay Rs.3,000/- (Rupees Three Thousand) per month to the complainant and other litigation is also pending between the parties.
5. As such, considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the Trial Court Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.6390 of 2025(3) dt.09-05-2025 within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sheohar, in connection with Complaint Case No.
C1-151/2021, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.

6. It is made clear that as per the assurance given by the petitioner to this Court, he shall pay Rs.
3,000/- (Rupees Three Thousand) every month to the complainant/O.P. No.2 directly in her account.
The complainant/O.P. No.2 is directed to provide the details of her account to the petitioner or his counsel for the said remuneration.

(Dr. Anshuman, J) Divyansh/-
